verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents exporting traces via the UI or API, which is a first-party export path for its core data. Nothing shows a full-account export (datasets, evaluations, annotations, prompts) or which open formats exports use. Self-hosting keeps data in your own environment, but that is adjacent to exporting and leaving, not an export capability. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all data types, named open export formats (e.g., JSONL/CSV/OTel), offboarding/migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
